description.aim: My aim is to deliver efficient technological products to those in need of them, and then they receive good experience with the products and life will be better :)
description.focus: These days, I focus on designing and architecting frontend code (also UI component libraries), building web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js(CSR, SSR) including unit tests, and building pleasant and effective teams.

cleanCode.heading: Clean Code for Frontend
cleanCode.body: Frontend engineers always white humble parts and business parts. To test what the company wants to do, write strong and easy-to-change code at heart. Bonus: the code would be easy to change even for those with little front-end knowledge.

architecture.heading: Architecture...?
architecture.body: I am learning the architectures. It will change depending on the size and division of the service, so I always want to come up with an architecture that I think is the best right now for each service.

philosophy.heading: Philosophy
philosophy.body: Release is always "exciting" for me. I continue to try to reduce the worry when releasing as much as possible. I want to strengthen our cooperation with automated testing and QA teams.

team.heading: Love Teams
team.body: One of the important things when working is a Team for me. I believe that a good team can deliver a good product. What is a good team?, It depends on the teammates. For me, polite vibes, keep learning and improving, and work-life balance. I just want to hear, "what is a good team for you?".
